description: Gaia passbands: the (E)DR3 broad-band passbands (G, Gbp, Grp) and the DR3 Radial Velocity Spectrometer band (Grvs). The revised Gaia DR2 bright and faint BP passbands (Gbp_bright, Gbp_faint) are GAIA/Gaia2m.
short_description: Gaia (E)DR3 passbands: G, BP, RP and RVS
facility_description: Gaia is a European Space Agency astrometric, photometric and spectroscopic space observatory operating at the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point.
notes: G, Gbp and Grp are the Gaia (E)DR3 passbands and Grvs is the Gaia DR3 RVS passband: each curve's data rows are identical to SVO's GAIA/GAIA3 record of the same band (SVO description 'GAIA <band> filter, DR3'; SVO profile reference https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/edr3-passbands for G, Gbp and Grp, and https://www.cosmos.esa.int/web/gaia/dr3-passbands for Grvs). The revised Gaia DR2 bright and faint BP passbands (Gbp_bright, Gbp_faint) are GAIA/Gaia2m; until 2026-11-11 this set also held copies of them. The curves were compared with SVO captures of 2026-10-27. Pre-launch nominal passbands are described in Jordi et al. (2010). DetectorType (photon) is SVO's for all four bands and is left unchanged.
